tasks.short: Identify and obtain microsystem test equipment

steps.what: Identify characterization needs and assess available test equipment, instrumentation and facilities
Develop needed test arrangements or specify equipment and facility requirements for procurement
Check the resource specification and submit an authorized equipment or facility requisition

tasks.design: Keep equipment assessment, development and technical requisition checks with the engineer. Existing catalogues and native {PROCUREMENT} forms support the process without deciding measurement suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Characterization resources must match the actual device, measurement needs and facility constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Catalogue access supports known specifications but does not replace practical suitability assessment.
tasks.still_hard: Resolution, uncertainty, access and practical fixture behavior need engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognizes when nominal specifications cannot deliver a meaningful measurement.
tasks.altitude: Resource selection and development time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess test interfaces and measurement equipment suitability

evidence.claim: Test resource suitability and development remain engineering judgement; existing procurement forms do not establish a new labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary includes the engineer's resource assessment, development and technical requisition, excluding buyer commercial approval, supplier manufacturing and facility construction.
The engineer produces assessed needs in s1 and the resource specification in s2 before requisition in s3. No structured suitable-instrument flag is assumed.
Test native catalogue and procurement functions before custom code; this design introduces no new software or capture requirement.
Zero incremental upkeep because the process remains unchanged. Supplier and buyer work is not transferred or included in focal savings.
research_questions: Is repeated requisition transcription a distinct measured burden outside technical selection?

already_counted.description: Technical resource specification check and requisition

incremental.description: No introduced resource selection automation upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact resource specification, requested quantity, intended application and requisition checked before internal submission in s3; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Standard instruments and novel fixtures both retain technical suitability assessment and requisition checking.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and validate product test protocols

steps.what: Develop product-specific test methods, acceptance thresholds and inspection tool requirements
Assemble protocol steps, threshold tables and inspection instructions from the engineering specification
Validate test behavior and acceptance thresholds before accepting the product-specific protocol version

tasks.design: Configure controlled protocol templates in {DOCS} from engineer-defined methods and thresholds. The engineer retains method development, independent validation and exact-version acceptance; document assembly does not determine valid thresholds.
tasks.previous_blocker: Settled test details were recopied into formal protocol sections and threshold tables.
tasks.enabler_now: Controlled template fields can assemble a specified protocol consistently.
tasks.still_hard: Repeatability, measurement uncertainty and discriminatory power require physical validation.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides whether a test can distinguish acceptable product behavior from failure.
tasks.altitude: Protocol assembly shrinks while scientific validity and acceptance remain unchanged.

reach.task: Validate test interfaces and acceptance behavior

evidence.claim: Kneat supports controlled protocols and validation records; this supports document control rather than establishing correct microsystem acceptance thresholds.
The proposed protocol assembly workflow and savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes method and threshold development, protocol assembly and validation, excluding routine production testing after release.

The microsystems engineer produces in s1 product and revision, test order, setup, measurement method, units, acceptance thresholds with rationale, inspection tool settings, uncertainty considerations and independent validation cases. Development and capture remain fully counted; missing or unvalidated details require manual protocol preparation.
Test native controlled templates before custom code. No free pass/fail rule, acceptance threshold or validated-test flag is assumed.

Physical validation, checks of false acceptance and rejection, and acceptance retain all s3 time. Underlying test evidence generation is included in validation rather than assumed to appear automatically.
unknowns: Existing protocol templates and validation practice
research_questions: Does template assembly save time after threshold development and independent protocol validation?

already_counted.description: Physical protocol validation and version acceptance

incremental.description: Maintain controlled fields and threshold table mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact product revision, method, thresholds, inspection settings and independent validation findings accepted in s3; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus7 upkeep gives net13. Range0-3 assumes existing templates and little repeated assembly; method development and validation retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consider environmental issues in device designs

steps.what: Consider environmental issues and trade-offs when proposing microsystem product designs

tasks.design: Retain environmental design judgement with the engineer. Source material in {DOCS} supports reasoning without producing an automatic environmentally acceptable design decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Environmental considerations depend on material, process and lifecycle boundaries.
tasks.enabler_now: Searchable evidence helps reference use but does not settle design trade-offs.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete evidence and shifting impacts require explicit judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer identifies which environmental questions matter for the actual design.
tasks.altitude: Environmental consideration and design responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess lifecycle boundaries and environmental trade-offs
reach.learn: Evidence quality and limits of environmental claims

evidence.claim: Considering environmental trade-offs in design is contextual judgement; no repetitive calculation baseline is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is environmental consideration within a proposed design, excluding a separately commissioned lifecycle study or regulatory approval.
The engineer interprets source evidence directly; no structured environmentally preferable or compliant-design flag is assumed.
Test native document and existing assessment tools before custom code; no new software or source capture requirement is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because the design judgement process is unchanged.
unknowns: Relevant environmental boundaries and available material evidence
research_questions: Is any repeated quantitative assessment distinct from design consideration and worth measuring separately?

incremental.description: No introduced environmental design automation upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Well-understood materials and uncertain process impacts both retain environmental judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop energy products using nanomaterials or nanoprocesses

steps.what: Design or develop energy products using nanomaterials or nanoprocesses through engineering investigation

tasks.design: Keep novel energy product development with the engineer. Existing evidence and design records in {DOCS} support investigation without replacing material and process reasoning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Nanomaterial and process behavior require domain-specific investigation and validation.
tasks.enabler_now: Engineering tools support particular calculations but do not establish an automated replacement for novel development.
tasks.still_hard: Scale effects, reproducibility and manufacturability need evidence and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognizes unsupported extrapolation and chooses the next useful investigation.
tasks.altitude: Development time and technical responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Investigate nanomaterial behavior and process limitations

evidence.claim: Novel nanomaterial energy product development remains engineering investigation; no general task saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is novel product design and development, excluding routine documentation, separately counted model construction and production operation.
The engineer interprets development evidence directly; no structured viable-product or successful-process flag is assumed.
Use native engineering tool capabilities before custom code. Existing automatic calculations do not enter human baseline time.
Zero upkeep because no new development tool or workflow is introduced. Allocate any shared modeling or testing effort once in roll-ups.
unknowns: Product novelty and development evidence requirements
research_questions: Which routine preparation components are distinct from novel product judgement and already counted elsewhere?

incremental.description: No introduced product development automation upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Familiar material systems and novel nanoprocesses retain engineering investigation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protocol document assembly may shrink while resource suitability, validation, environmental trade-offs and novel product development remain with the engineer.
reach: Review measurement interfaces with electronics engineers
Investigate material behavior with materials engineers
role.ambitious_version: A microsystems engineer with controlled protocol preparation and unchanged responsibility for physical evidence and design judgement.
